description:
Build a structured citation for a single chunk.

Returns ``document_name``, ``materialized_path``, ``page_number`` (when
the chunk lives under a paginated SECTION), a short ``snippet``, and a
stable ``tag`` string (``[chunk:UUID]``) suitable for inline use in the
agent's prose.

Recommended usage: call ``cite`` once per chunk that backed an answer,
then append the ``tag`` to the relevant sentence and surface the rest
(document, path, page, snippet) in a footnote / sources block.

chunk_id.description: Chunk id to build a citation for — typically the ``chunk_id`` from a ``search_knowledge`` / ``search_keyword`` hit. NOT a ``path_part_id``.
chunk_id.title: Chunk Id

name: cite

outputSchema.description:
Compact citation payload for a single chunk.

Designed to be appended verbatim to an agent's prose answer. The ``tag``
field is a stable inline reference (``[chunk:UUID]``); ``snippet`` is a
short excerpt suitable for tooltips or footnotes; ``materialized_path``
+ ``page_number`` give a human-readable source location.

page_number.description: Page number of the chunk's nearest SECTION ancestor, when available. May be None for non-paginated documents (web pages, plain text).
page_number.title: Page Number

snippet.description: Up to ~240 chars of the chunk text, suitable for a footnote.
snippet.title: Snippet

tag.description: Inline reference token: ``[chunk:UUID]``. Append to the sentence in the agent's answer that the chunk supports.
tag.title: Tag

outputSchema.title: Citation
